name: Overlook
notes: Flixer-style front-end. Player is loaded from the shared API farms, so the headless network sniffer finds the media URL without site-specific code. Link pattern may need a tweak once we see the rendered search page on your LAN.

name: Cinevo
notes: Dutch-oriented front-end; TMDB based. Best treated with the browser sniffer.

name: Cinejoy
notes: Encrypted player API (POST /g on api.wing.st, decrypted by a WASM blob in the browser). Native decryption is planned as layer 3; until then the browser sniffer reads the URL *after* the site decrypted it, which is the pragmatic path.

name: Flixhub
notes: Flixer clone; same farms as Overlook/1flex.

name: Redflix
notes: Aggregator front-end. If its own search is JS-only, the search page may need selector tuning — the resolve path is unaffected.

name: 1flex
notes: Flixer clone (same player farm as Overlook/Flixhub).

name: Cinezo
notes: Open player API — a native adapter can be added as a fast path (kind:api) once the endpoint shape is confirmed from your network.
